metadata.longDescription: The lights go out for the first F1 Academy race of 2026 in Shanghai! Get to know all 11 rookies that are lining up on the grid alongside 6 returning drivers, including Alisha Palmowski and Rafaela Ferreira who give their new team-mate Megan Bruce some insider knowledge on F1 Academy.
metadata.shortDescription: The lights go out for the first F1 Academy race of 2026 in Shanghai!

metadata.longDescription: F1 Academy roars into Canada for Round 2 of the 2026 season! Along with highlights from qualifying and all three races we catch up with new series leader Emma Felbermayr, and Alba Larsen, Nina Gademan and Esmee Kosterman face the famous wall of champions in a mystery challenge – this is one not to be missed!
metadata.shortDescription: Nina Gademan and Esmee Kosterman face the famous wall of champions in a mystery challenge.
metadata.title: Weekend Wrapped - Canada

metadata.longDescription: The home of motorsport in the UK plays host to round 3 of F1 Academy 2026. Alongside qualifying and race highlights, we tested Alisha Palmwoski, Rachel Robertson and Ella Lloyd’s Silverstone knowledge under unusual conditions, and we chatted to Mathilda Paatz, Ella Stevens, Rafaela Ferreira and Megan Bruce over afternoon tea about their motorsport firsts.
metadata.shortDescription: Alisha Palmwoski, Rachel Robertson and Ella Lloyd’s Silverstone knowledge is put to the test.
metadata.title: Weekend Wrapped - Great Britain

metadata.longDescription: Alba Larsen and Payton Westcott reveal exactly what it takes to be an F1 Academy driver and challenge their team-mates to a painting competition – with hilarious results.
